note.after_visit_summary:
Your blood pressure is still higher than our goal of under 130 over 80, even though you have been taking lisinopril. Your heart, lungs, and blood tests for potassium and kidney function all look fine. Your cholesterol level is right where we want it.

We will increase your lisinopril to a stronger dose. Until your new bottle arrives, take two of your 20 mg tablets together each morning. Keep taking your cholesterol medicine, atorvastatin 40 mg, at night.

Please try to cut back on salt and aim for less than 2000 mg a day. Deli meat and chips are high in salt, so packing your lunch may help.

Come back for blood work in about 2 weeks, and again in 6 weeks. Check your blood pressure at home and bring your log to your visits.

Call us or go to the emergency room right away if your top number goes over 180, or if you get a severe headache, chest pain, or weakness on one side.
